steps.en: Officer decides to manually submit a rejected record in ICMS
steps.id: Officer memutuskan submit manual record ditolak di ICMS
steps.why_en: No screen or option exists for this decision.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar atau pilihan untuk keputusan ini.

steps.en: Processing stage is updated after the decision
steps.why_en: Nothing changes the stage based on a court decision.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang mengubah tahap berdasarkan keputusan court.

steps.en: A new court application batch number is assigned
steps.id: Nomor batch court application baru diberikan
steps.why_en: No batch number is created or stored for court applications.
steps.why_id: Nomor batch court application tidak dibuat atau disimpan.

steps.en: The batch goes to State Courts so the outcome can return
steps.id: Batch dikirim ke State Courts agar hasil bisa kembali
steps.why_en: No job sends court application batches; only a connection setting exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada job yang mengirim batch court application; hanya ada pengaturan koneksi.
